name: instagram-marketing
cost: Free for drafts. Auto-posting uses Publora (free sign-up); optional Pixfaro images are paid per image
works_with: Claude Code, Codex, claude.ai, Claude Desktop, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent and others through npx skills
short: Nine Instagram skills that write captions, plan carousels and weekly posts, size hashtags and audit your profile, with your approval first.
what: A bundle of 9 skills for Instagram: caption writer, carousel planner, hook extractor, hashtag strategist, humanizer, content planner, repurposer, profile optimizer and audience insights. You supply the image or video and the skills write the words. Every draft waits for your OK, and with Publora connected the skills can upload your media and schedule the post.
who: Creators, marketers and small businesses who post on Instagram and use an AI agent. Auto-posting needs an Instagram Business or Creator account.
needs: For auto-posting: a free Publora account, your Publora API key and Instagram platform ID, an Instagram Business or Creator account, and the Python packages requests and python-dotenv
Audience Insights reads niche and profile data through Apify

try.label: From the README
try.text: Write me an Instagram caption about how I cut my editing time from 6 hours to 47 minutes. Hook in the first line.

watch: Auto-posting sends your media and captions through Publora, a third-party service connected to your Instagram account.
Instagram rejects text-only posts. Without media, the skill gives you the caption to paste into the app.
Personal Instagram accounts can't use the publishing API.
Pixfaro image generation is a paid API, priced by model.
After an approved draft, the skill may close the session with one line asking you to star the repo.
